data.one_liner: Dropbox client for Flutter supporting Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin for accessing Dropbox storage. It supports user authorization via the Dropbox app or a web browser, along with listing, uploading, and downloading files.
use_when: You need to integrate Dropbox file storage and syncing into your Flutter application.
You want to allow users to authenticate with Dropbox using OAuth or PKCE flow.
avoid_when: You require a backend-agnostic storage client or support for non-Android/iOS platforms (like web or desktop).
You prefer pure Dart solutions without complex native setup steps.
strengths: Supports both legacy authorization and modern OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow.
Provides file upload and download progress callbacks.
Supports listing folders and fetching temporary links.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.
Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
Requires app delegate code modifications for iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires registering a Dropbox API app, modifying AndroidManifest.xml, and updating Info.plist and AppDelegate (Swift or Objective-C) for iOS.
